about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Saint Matthew, Apostle and Evangelist” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Having received Your sacrament, O Lord, we implore You, that what we have celebrated in honor of St. Matthew, Your Apostle and Evangelist, may by his intercession, benefit us as a healing remedy. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
